newsitem.title: USA: Lotto World seeks capital investment.
newsitem.headline: Lotto World seeks capital investment.

text.p: Lotto World Inc said Tuesday it needs additional capital investment or it will need to reduce substantially its operations.
The company said it is currently negotiating additional capital investments with several firms.
In its Form 10-QSB for the period ended March 31, Lotto World said it has faced lagging advertising revenue from its New York Lottery Players Monthly magazine.
If the company cannot secure additional capital, Lotto World said, it will be delisted from the Nasdaq market and will be traded on the OTC bulletin board market.
